title: Conversations, connected.
name: Support Chat Core
summary: A Laravel support-chat core connecting a visitor widget with a human support team through Server-Sent Events.
problem: A reusable support-chat foundation needs to coordinate visitor messages, human operators and conversation state.
implementation: The public source includes conversation and message models, visitor and operator endpoints, and an SSE stream that notifies clients when new events exist.
decision: The event stream emits event metadata; clients retrieve the message content separately. The inspected implementation uses short-lived streaming requests.
limits: The README describes this as a non-AI core. Source inspection is not a deployment, scalability or security certification.

title: When things break, know.
name: Laravel Exception Alert
summary: A configurable Laravel package that sends exception details by email without replacing an application’s report or render methods.
problem: Application errors need a direct route to the developer without a disruptive integration.
implementation: A trait registers a Laravel reportable callback, checks configuration, sends a Mailable and catches delivery failures. The package documents install, test and uninstall commands.
decision: The inspected trait sends synchronously by default. The alert is configurable by exception status, with failures logged rather than allowed to escape the mail block.
limits: No installation counts, production adoption or response-time improvements are claimed. Framework compatibility should be checked for each consuming application.
code:
php artisan exception-alert:install
php artisan exception-alert:test

title: One product. Clear boundaries.
name: Multi-company Chat Platform
summary: A Laravel application with company sites, human-agent workspaces and company-scoped conversation handling.
problem: A support platform needs separate workspaces for administrators, companies and support operators.
implementation: Routes define these workspaces and a widget script endpoint. The inspected chat controller scopes queries to the operator’s company and checks company ownership before conversation actions.
decision: Conversation join, reply, close and leave are explicit actions; replies require assignment to the current human operator.
limits: The README is framework boilerplate. These descriptions are limited to inspected routes and controller code. AI behavior, billing, deployment and commercial usage are not verified.
